gloss: natural trait; inherent quality; one's own

definitions.gloss: natural trait; inherent quality; innate characteristic
definitions.explanation: A quality, ability, or characteristic that someone naturally possesses. Almost always used in a positive sense to describe admirable traits that come naturally to a person.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|あか}るさ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
examples.english: She got through it with her natural cheerfulness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いた→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
examples.english: He ran all the way to the end with his natural stamina.

examples.japanese: {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動力|こうどうりょく}→行動力：08522_koudouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かして→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She leveraged her natural drive to action and made the new project a success.

notes:
Literally 'what one holds from before' — a quality that has been part of someone since birth or from a very early stage. Almost exclusively used in a positive or admiring context to describe desirable traits. Typically used as a modifier in the pattern {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + [positive trait].

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{明|あか}るさ: natural cheerfulness
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}さ: innate perseverance
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧: natural stamina
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行動力|こうどうりょく}→行動力：08522_koudouryoku⟧: natural drive to act
- {持|も}ち{前|まえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦センス→センス：10468_sensu⟧: natural sense/flair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{生|う}まれつき→生まれつき：21201_umaretsuki⟧: innate, from birth — can describe both positive and negative traits; more neutral
- ⟦{天性|てんせい}→天性：23367_tensei⟧: natural disposition — more literary; emphasizes heaven-given talent
- ⟦{素質|そしつ}→素質：04046_soshitsu⟧: natural aptitude — focuses on latent ability rather than observable traits
